body:
Mula v1.2.61: pindutin lang ang "I-update" sa app. Mga 5 MB lang ang download.
Mula v1.2.49 hanggang v1.2.60: i-install lang ang update, hindi na kailangang i-uninstall.
Mula v1.2.48 o mas luma: i-uninstall muna ang lumang E-Tarabay. Babalik ang stars, awards at progress pagka-sign in ulit.

From v1.2.61: just tap "Update" in the app. The download is only about 5 MB. From v1.2.49 to v1.2.60: just install the update. From v1.2.48 or older: uninstall the old E-Tarabay first; your stars, awards and progress come back when you sign in.

I-download / Download: https://jaijr711.github.io/etarabay-releases/

Pagka-update

- Wala nang kailangang gawin.

Bago

- Ito ang unang update na ang binago lang ang dina-download: mga 5 MB mula v1.2.61, hindi na 117 MB.

Para sa teacher at magulang

- Hindi na makakagawa ng account ng bata hangga't kulang ang impormasyon. Kailangan nang piliin ang kasarian (wala nang naka-default na "Lalaki"), ilagay ang kaarawan, at tamang pangalan at apelyido.
- Dapat 2 hanggang 7 taong gulang ang bata ayon sa kaarawan, para mahuli ang maling taon.
- Ang numero ng magulang ay dapat 11 digit at nagsisimula sa 09.
- May pulang mensahe sa ilalim ng bawat kulang, at sinasabi ng app kung ano mismo ang kulang, gaya ng "Kulang pa: Kasarian, Kaarawan".
- Pareho ang tuntunin sa pag-edit, at hindi na mabubura ang kaarawan.
- Sa Talaan ng Guro, may pulang tandang "Kulang ang info" ang batang naka-enroll na pero kulang ang impormasyon. Pindutin ito para kumpletuhin.

---

After updating

- Nothing to do.

New

- This is the first update that downloads only what changed: about 5 MB from v1.2.61 instead of 117 MB.

For teachers and parents

- A child's account can no longer be made while details are missing. Gender must now be chosen (it no longer starts as "Boy"), and a birthday and a proper first and last name are required.
- The birthday must make the child 2 to 7 years old, to catch a wrong year.
- The parent's number must be 11 digits starting with 09.
- Each missing field gets a red message under it, and the app names exactly what is missing, such as "Still missing: Gender, Birthday".
- Editing follows the same rules, and a birthday can no longer be removed.
- In the class list, a child already enrolled with missing details shows a red "Info incomplete" mark. Tap it to complete them.
